description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE V (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_V PRIMARY KEY, V LONGBINARY); Close. Then 1 session(s), each adding one row through a table recordset (AddNew, ID, V, Update) and closing: IDs 1-1 with V a Long Binary of 14,000 patterned bytes (4,072 + 4,072 + 4,072 + 1,784 = 4 chain pages). Page 0 bytes 3584-3591, page 1 and pages 42-53 are read after the create session and after each insert session (pages 0-55 hashed after the last), and FieldSize read back at the end. Asks where each value is placed (inline, single LVAL row, chained pages) and which page(s) it takes.
